description: The current hardware provides an LDR/relative light reading. Scientific hydroponic references commonly use PPFD and DLI. PPFD and DLI cannot be directly substituted with raw LDR values. A fixed LDR operating range should only be created after calibration against a suitable light measurement. DLI around 14-17 mol/m2/day may be stored as a literature reference for controlled hydroponic spinach environments, but this must not be presented as an LDR value. It provides supporting context for interpretation.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: TDS is related to dissolved-solute concentration and should be interpreted alongside EC. It is a supporting nutrient-solution parameter. No independent hard optimal range is provided without a validated source.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: Salinity is a supporting solution parameter. No independent hard optimal range is provided without a validated source.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: The current baseline defines OPTIMAL according to the project stage-aware pH/EC rules. It is a baseline classification. It is not laboratory confirmation of nutrient concentration. Other environmental variables should still be considered.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: The current baseline defines NON_OPTIMAL when the stage-aware pH/EC conditions fall outside the defined baseline range. It does not identify a specific nutrient deficiency. It should trigger contextual investigation using sensor trends, plant images, Health prediction, Growth context and plant history when available.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: The current model uses pH, EC, temperature, humidity, light, and growth-stage context/proxy to predict the baseline nutrient-status class (OPTIMAL or NON_OPTIMAL). This model is not an N/P/K concentration predictor.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: EARLY maps to G0, G1. MIDDLE maps to G2. LATE maps to G3, G4. This is the stage grouping used for the current nutrient baseline and can later be replaced/refined when the real Growth Intelligence model is available.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.

description: A nutrient-model prediction must not be treated as a standalone diagnosis. The platform should combine sensor measurements, model predictions, growth context, image evidence and historical observations before generating an explanation or recommendation.
reference_note: Reference values are context-dependent and are not universal biological thresholds.
